note.zh: 本周检查了 18 个出发机场的 Frontier 官方公开低价页。页面报价未说明具体行程是否直飞，故本轮没有新增已核实的低于 $100 直飞报价；9 月旧报价保留原观察时间并标为历史。SAP 出发方向本轮未核实。未核实不代表无航班或无低价，公开报价也不是 GoWild 库存。
note.en: This week reviewed Frontier public deal pages for 18 origin airports. Those pages do not establish whether each priced itinerary is nonstop, so no new verified under-$100 nonstop quote was added. September observations keep their original timestamps and are historical. SAP-origin pricing was not verified. Unverified does not mean no flight or low fare; public quotes are not GoWild inventory.
